definition: a very hard, sparkling stone used in jewelry
description: A wood-panelled auction room. A young woman with braided hair, a cream blazer and white gloves sits at a green table and holds up a sparkling cut diamond with tweezers into a beam of sunlight, turning it and sending rainbow sparkles across the room, then smiles. A black tray of rings lies in front of her. Behind a rope barrier the audience watches, a woman laughing and a man shielding his eyes from the glare, while a guard in a dark suit and white gloves stands by.

en.question: What is the woman with braids holding?

de.answer: Sie hält einen Diamanten mit einer Pinzette.
de.question: Was hält die Frau mit den Zöpfen?

es.answer: Está sosteniendo un diamante con unas pinzas.
es.question: ¿Qué está sosteniendo la mujer de las trenzas?

fr.answer: Elle tient un diamant avec une pince à épiler.
fr.question: Que tient la femme aux tresses ?
